MP Hospital Investigates Infant's Loss of Eyesight After Medication Error

A 19-month-old child has reportedly lost eyesight after being taken to a hospital in Madhya Pradesh. The incident occurred when nasal drops were allegedly administered into the infant's eyes instead of the nose. The hospital has initiated an investigation into the matter.
